title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Share of Guaranty Carried Forward by Time from Closing to Release
content:
On a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan assumed by a buyer, the guaranty carried forward depends on how soon after the loan's closing date the seller's release comes, counting whole months from the closing date on the loan record to today.

## Assumption-timing share

| Release comes | Share of the guaranty carried forward |
|---|---|
| Less than 5 years (60 whole months) after the closing date | The early-assumption share, 95 percent |
| At least 5 years but less than 10 years (120 whole months) after closing | The middle-assumption share, 98 percent |
| Otherwise (10 years or more after closing) | The whole, 100 percent |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, whole months from closing to today)

| Whole months | Share |
|---|---|
| 59 | 95 |
| 60 | 98 |
| 119 | 98 |
| 120 | 100 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A guaranty of 80,000.00 dollars on a loan that closed 75 whole months before today is carried forward at 98 percent: 80,000.00 multiplied by 98 and divided by one hundred, or 78,400.00 dollars.
